fusions.name: Full-Tilt Thrust
fusions.desc: Hurls a lance-length spike at an enemy up to 8 tiles away that deals 30 damage, rising to 1.8 times as much at full reach, plus 5% of a boss's or elite's maximum health.

fusions.name: Stampede
fusions.desc: Tramples through a cone ahead of you on spiked hooves, dealing 12 damage to everything within 4 tiles and knocking each back 3 tiles, with a 40% chance to leave each [Bleeding] for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Lance Raised
fusions.desc: Raises a barrier that absorbs up to 18 damage for 6 seconds. You move 25% faster for 4 seconds after you use it.

fusions.name: Gathered Momentum
fusions.desc: Every 6 tiles you cover raises your physical damage by 25% for 4 seconds. Once every 8 seconds.
